from cyhole.helius.client import PostGetAssetsByOwnerBody


def list_das_assets_by_owner(wallet_address: str) -> list:
    api_key = os.environ["HELIUS_API_KEY"]
    helius = Helius(api_key=api_key)

    assets = []
    page = 1
    limit = 1000

    while True:
        body = PostGetAssetsByOwnerBody(

            page=page,
            limit=limit,
        )
        response = helius.client.post_get_assets_by_owner(body)
        items = response.result.items

            break
        page += 1
